title: Decoded constant-pair Boolean function
statement: For each natural number $n$, the Boolean function is obtained by decoding the indicator of the pair consisting of the zero vector and the all-ones vector in $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the decoding operation or the Boolean function's codomain, so its exact values cannot be rendered.
